changes: Restore a verified fallback manifest to the current path before shared-store refreshes, preserving the prior backup and canonical receipt references.
Spend one monotonic deadline on both the thread lock and process flock during checkpoint close; return incomplete without changing persisted evidence if contention exhausts it.
Retain the Portal preflight-store handle and raise a timeout when checkpoint close is incomplete, permitting an explicit retry.
Select literal Git paths so names such as [slot].py cannot capture unrelated staged changes.
Decode Git diff bytes without universal-newline conversion; preserve CRLF for staged edits, additions, deletions and untracked additions; disable external diff/text conversion.
